dialogues.speaker: Odolf
dialogues.text: I'll be honest. We locals never really liked him. Not so much that we hated him either, though...

dialogues.speaker: Odolf
dialogues.text: As for the Knights, well, that's different. I dreamed of joining them when I was young, but I ended up taking over my dad's stall at the Guild, and that was that...

dialogues.speaker: Odolf
dialogues.text: The knights who fought the Abyss and fell in those ruins... they were heroes. And heroes deserve better than that.

dialogues.speaker: Odolf
dialogues.text: I won't deny it — it did feel pretty good seeing him get scared stiff by the "ghosts." But that's still not how anyone should be living...

dialogues.speaker: Odolf
dialogues.text: Recently, though... he's been easier to talk to. Comes to us now and then to discuss things. Not how I thought it'd go, but I guess it's a happy accident.
